source: Wang, Fu, Baarholm, Wu & Larsen (2014), Marine Structures 39, 131-156 (the model riser, Table 2); Thorsen, Saevik & Larsen (2017), Marine Structures 51, 134-151 (Table 1, Sec. 5.1, Figs. 17-18)
data_used: the model riser properties; the 25 measured r.m.s. dynamic cross-flow strains of Fig. 17 (read from the vector figure, axes calibrated on its tick marks; the simulated maximum of the same figure reads 99.6 % of the measured one, as the text states); the measured dominant frequency 1.00 Hz 8.25 m from the lower end
coefficients: Thorsen et al. (2017) for this case, not tuned: Cv 0.7, f0 0.18, df 0.08 (cross-flow only), CD 1.2, CM 2
